meta.title: Step 5B Pilot — Cross-Subject Sorting, Classification, Matching & Cloze (sort-classify 1.0.0)
meta.subject: Cross-Subject (Biology, Chemistry, Maths, Accounting, English, Phonics, Geography, Computing)

slides.title: 1. Biology — Vertebrate Classification
slides.purpose: Classify organisms into Mammals, Birds, and Reptiles with misconception-specific feedback.
onScreenText: Dolphins and bats are mammals, not fish or birds

visual.svgCode: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 450" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#f8fafc"/><text x="400" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Biology — Vertebrate Classification</text></svg>

narration.script: Classify each vertebrate into Mammals, Birds, or Reptiles based on its biological characteristics.

keyIdeas: Warm-bloodedness, fur/hair, and milk production define mammals.

interactive.title: Classify Vertebrates into Their Biological Class
interactive.instructions: Select each animal and place it in the correct vertebrate class.
interactive.fallbackText: Mammals: Bat, Dolphin; Birds: Eagle; Reptiles: Crocodile.

misconceptionByBin.birds: Bats fly, but they have fur and nurse their young with milk — they are mammals!

interactive.successExplanation: Both bats and dolphins are mammals despite living in the air and sea.

slides.title: 2. Mathematics — Overlapping Set Membership
slides.purpose: Assign integers to overlapping sets (Multiples of 2 and Multiples of 3).
onScreenText: Overlapping sets allow an element to belong to BOTH sets
6 and 12 lie in the intersection A ∩ B

visual.svgCode: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 450" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#f8fafc"/><text x="400" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Mathematics — Overlapping Set Membership</text></svg>

narration.script: Assign each number to all sets it belongs to. Remember a number like 6 belongs to both multiples of 2 and multiples of 3.

keyIdeas: Intersection elements belong simultaneously to both sets.

interactive.title: Assign Numbers to Overlapping Sets A (Even) & B (Multiples of 3)
interactive.instructions: Place each number into EVERY set it belongs to (leave 5 unassigned if it belongs to neither).
interactive.fallbackText: 4 -> Set A; 9 -> Set B; 6 -> both Set A and Set B; 5 -> neither.
interactive.successExplanation: 6 ∈ A ∩ B because it is divisible by both 2 and 3; 5 ∈ (A ∪ B)'.

slides.title: 3. Chemistry — Elements, Compounds & Mixtures
slides.purpose: Distinguish pure elements, chemically bonded compounds, and physical mixtures.
onScreenText: Elements contain one type of atom

visual.svgCode: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 450" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#f8fafc"/><text x="400" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Chemistry — Elements, Compounds & Mixtures</text></svg>

narration.script: Classify each substance as an Element, a Compound, or a Mixture.

keyIdeas: Air and salt water are mixtures; O₂ is an element; H₂O is a compound.

interactive.title: Classify Substances: Element, Compound, or Mixture
interactive.instructions: Sort each substance into its correct chemical category.
interactive.fallbackText: Element: Oxygen gas (O₂); Compound: Water (H₂O), Sodium chloride (NaCl); Mixture: Air.

misconceptionByBin.comp: O₂ has two atoms, but both are oxygen — it is still a single element.

slides.title: 4. Accounting — Assets, Liabilities & Equity + Debit/Credit (Multi-Activity Slide)
slides.purpose: Verify two independent Accounting classification activities on one slide.
onScreenText: Debit increases Assets; Credit increases Liabilities & Equity

visual.svgCode: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 450" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#f8fafc"/><text x="400" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Accounting — Balance Sheet & Debit/Credit</text></svg>

narration.script: Classify balance-sheet items into Assets, Liabilities, or Equity, and match normal account balances.

interactive.title: Classify Accounts: Asset, Liability, or Equity
interactive.instructions: Place each account in Assets, Liabilities, or Owner's Equity.
interactive.fallbackText: Assets: Cash at Bank, Inventory; Liabilities: Trade Payables; Equity: Owner's Capital.

interactive.title: Match Account Categories to Normal Balance (Many-to-Many)
interactive.instructions: Link each account type to its normal balance side (Debit or Credit).
interactive.fallbackText: Assets & Expenses -> Debit; Liabilities & Revenue -> Credit.

slides.title: 5. English Grammar — Cloze Tiles (Reusable Tokens)
slides.purpose: Complete a sentence with reusable grammatical tokens.
onScreenText: Choose the correct preposition or auxiliary verb for each gap
Tokens may be reused where enabled

visual.svgCode: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 450" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#f8fafc"/><text x="400" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">English Grammar — Reusable Cloze Tiles</text></svg>

narration.script: Select each blank and pick the correct grammatical token from the bank. You may reuse tokens.

interactive.title: Complete Subject–Verb Agreement (Reusable Tokens)
interactive.instructions: Select each blank and fill it with 'is' or 'are'.
interactive.accessibilityLabel: English subject verb agreement cloze tiles
interactive.fallbackText: The mango is ripe, the oranges are sweet, and the basket is full.
interactive.template: The mango {{b1}} ripe, the oranges {{b2}} sweet, and the basket {{b3}} full.

slides.title: 6. Early Years Phonics — Short Vowel Sorting
slides.purpose: Sort CVC words by their middle short vowel sound.

visual.svgCode: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 450" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#f8fafc"/><text x="400" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Phonics — Short Vowel Sound Sorting</text></svg>

narration.script: Sort each CVC word into Short a or Short i.

keyIdeas: Middle vowel phonemes distinguish CVC word families.

interactive.title: Sort CVC Words by Short Vowel Sound
interactive.instructions: Place each word in the Short 'a' or Short 'i' bin.
interactive.fallbackText: Short a: cat, map; Short i: pin, sit.

slides.title: 7. Geography — River Landform Matching
slides.purpose: Match river landforms to their dominant geomorphological process.

visual.svgCode: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 450" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#f8fafc"/><text x="400" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Geography — River Landform Matching</text></svg>

narration.script: Match each river landform to the process that forms it.

keyIdeas: Erosion dominates steep upper courses; deposition dominates flat lower courses.

interactive.title: Match River Landforms to Dominant Processes
interactive.instructions: Link each landform to its primary formation process.
interactive.fallbackText: Waterfall -> Erosion; Delta -> Deposition; Ox-bow Lake -> Both Erosion & Deposition.

slides.title: 8. Science — Scientific Method Sequencing (Multiple Valid Orders)

visual.svgCode: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 450" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#f8fafc"/><text x="400" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Science — Ordering the Scientific Method</text></svg>

narration.script: Use the up and down arrows to place the stages of a scientific investigation in logical order.

keyIdeas: A testable hypothesis precedes controlled experimentation.

interactive.title: Order the Stages of a Scientific Investigation
interactive.instructions: Arrange the 4 steps from first to last.
interactive.accessibilityLabel: Order stages of a scientific investigation
interactive.fallbackText: 1. Observe a phenomenon, 2. Form a hypothesis, 3. Run a fair test, 4. Draw a conclusion.

items.label: Analyse data and draw a conclusion

slides.title: 9. Computer Science — Input, Output & Storage Devices
onScreenText: Touchscreens can act as both input and output

visual.svgCode: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 450" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#f8fafc"/><text x="400" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Computer Science — Hardware Classification</text></svg>

narration.script: Classify each hardware device as Input, Output, or Storage.

keyIdeas: Touchscreen belongs to both Input and Output.

interactive.title: Classify Hardware: Input, Output, or Storage
interactive.instructions: Assign each device to all categories it serves (hint: touchscreen serves two!).
interactive.fallbackText: Keyboard -> Input; Printer -> Output; SSD -> Storage; Touchscreen -> Input & Output.

slides.title: 10. Science Vocabulary — Non-Reusable Cloze & Multi-Activity Check
slides.purpose: Verify non-reusable cloze tiles and multiple valid synonym tokens.
onScreenText: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy

visual.svgCode: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 450" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="450" fill="#f8fafc"/><text x="400" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Biology — Photosynthesis Definition Cloze</text></svg>

narration.script: Complete the photosynthesis definition using each token at most once.

keyIdeas: Chlorophyll absorbs light; glucose and oxygen are produced.

interactive.title: Complete the Photosynthesis Summary
interactive.instructions: Fill each blank using a token once.
interactive.fallbackText: Plants use chlorophyll to trap light energy and produce glucose and oxygen.
interactive.template: Plants use {{p1}} to absorb light energy and produce {{p2}} and {{p3}}.

interactive.title: Classify Business Costs: Fixed vs Variable
interactive.instructions: Classify each cost as Fixed or Variable.
interactive.fallbackText: Fixed: Factory Rent; Variable: Raw Materials, Packaging per unit.
